title: node-signed
description: A node signed as the day's work in the working copy; a file changed since it was opened, stopped; or why not.

conflict.description: The file changed since it was opened: nothing is signed.

revision.description: The revision signed; signing does not raise it.

opened.description: The SHA-256 of the file as it now is.

findings.description: What the node's checks found that does not refuse it: its warnings.

newer_on_drive.description: Group files changed on the drive since the copy was made: what they say is checked again when the work is put back.

writer.description: On a conflict, who wrote the file as it now is.

theirs.description: On a conflict, the file as it now is, as base64.
